textRuns.value: Blue = fighter above the division average, orange = below (not good or bad) · division = weight class of the fighter's latest fight, Catchweight / Open Weight skipped · division average pooled over all fights in that weight class, all eras · rates per 15 min of fight time · rounds without round stats excluded · control time includes clinch control · position shares are of landed significant strikes · two fighters with the same name are counted together
